construct_can_advance_to_display_conside: Holm-adjusted primary test rejects at familywise alpha 0.05
at least 5 of 8 frozen week statistics are positive
authorization_rule.failed_construct: not authorized for V1 production display; cannot be rescue-tuned on the same 8-week evidence
authorization_rule.position_display_after_construct_pass: only positions whose equal-week mean construct effect is positive

historical_retrospective_path.reason: B37 did not prove a reproducible full-universe historical pre-kickoff NextDyne snapshot archive.

identity_contract.research_match: exact normalized player name + canonical current NFL team + position

inference.multiple_construct_control: Holm step-down across the 3 primary constructs
inference.null: week-cluster sign-flip of the 8 frozen week statistics

next_stage.after_8_eligible_origins_complete: open realized targets exactly once under this frozen protocol
next_stage.after_protocol_freeze: freeze first eligible pre-kickoff predictor snapshot

pooling.group_statistic: Spearman correlation within origin_week x position for each construct
pooling.position_group_below_minimum: unavailable for that week, not zero
pooling.primary_effect: equal-weight mean of the 8 frozen week statistics
pooling.week_statistic: equal-weight mean of available QB/RB/WR/TE group correlations

predictor_architecture.normalization: within position and origin week using deterministic midranks
predictor_architecture.projection_strength_pct: within-position percentile of NextDyne central projection
predictor_architecture.volatility_width_pct: within-position percentile of NextDyne ceiling minus floor
predictor_architecture.why_relative_features_are_primary: Tests whether floor/ceiling contain incremental weekly ordering information beyond the provider's own central projection.

ceiling_upside.interpretation: Higher ceiling rank relative to projection rank should be associated with better-than-projection realized rank.

floor_resilience.interpretation: Higher floor rank relative to projection rank should be associated with better-than-projection realized rank.

volatility_width.interpretation: Wider model bands should be associated with larger absolute weekly projection-rank misses.

prospective_origin_contract.eligible_origins: first 8 chronologically captured 2026 regular-season NextDyne weekly snapshots frozen before that week's earliest actual NFL kickoff
prospective_origin_contract.missed_week: permanently ineligible; continue unchanged to later week until 8 eligible origins are accumulated

realized_target_contract.eligible_realized_row: snapshot player with an independently resolved realized weekly stats row
realized_target_contract.realized_strength_pct: within-position/week midrank percentile of realized Half-PPR among matched eligible rows

secondary_non_gating_diagnostics: matched-row coverage by week and position
